projects.title: AI Analytics Dashboard & Real-Time Customer Insights Hub
projects.description: We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Engineer to architect and build our flagship analytics portal. The project requires integrating complex data visualizations (charts, heatmaps, cohort tables), real-time WebSocket feeds for user telemetry, and a clean responsive UI built in React + TypeScript. The backend will interface with our predictive inference REST endpoints and require clean state management, modular components, and bulletproof security.

projects.title: Modern Mobile-First E-Commerce Storefront with Stripe Checkout
projects.description: Looking for a senior frontend developer to build an ultra-fast, high-converting digital product store. Needs responsive product grids, category filtering, cart drawer with optimistic updates, Stripe checkout integration, and 100/100 Lighthouse performance scores.

projects.title: Design System & Component Library in Figma for SaaS Suite
projects.description: We need a seasoned Product Designer to organize, standardize, and expand our Figma design system. You will audit 4 existing web apps, establish coherent color palettes, typography scales, elevation tokens, form controls, and interactive component variants with autolayout.

projects.title: Kubernetes Cluster Hardening & Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD
projects.description: Seeking a senior DevOps engineer to audit our production Kubernetes deployment, implement Helm charts, set up Prometheus/Grafana monitoring dashboards, and create automated lint-test-build-deploy GitHub Action workflows.
